name: Uptime Kuma
description: A fancy self-hosted monitoring tool that you can use to monitor websites, APIs, and Docker containers.
defaultCompose:
services:
  uptime-kuma:
    image: louislam/uptime-kuma:1
    container_name: uptime-kuma
    volumes:
      - ./uptime-kuma-data:/app/data
    ports:
      - 3001:3001
    restart: always

name: Nginx Proxy Manager
description: Expose your services easily and securely with a web UI for managing Nginx reverse proxies and Let's Encrypt certificates.
defaultCompose:
services:
  app:
    image: 'jc21/nginx-proxy-manager:latest'
    restart: unless-stopped
    ports:
      - '80:80'
      - '81:81'
      - '443:443'
    volumes:
      - ./data:/data
      - ./letsencrypt:/etc/letsencrypt

name: Pi-hole
description: A DNS sinkhole that protects your devices from unwanted content, without installing any client-side software.
defaultCompose:
services:
  pihole:
    container_name: pihole
    image: pihole/pihole:latest
    ports:
      - "53:53/tcp"
      - "53:53/udp"
      - "8080:80/tcp"
    environment:
      TZ: "America/Chicago"
      WEBPASSWORD: "${WEBPASSWORD}"
    volumes:
      - './etc-pihole:/etc/pihole'
      - './etc-dnsmasq.d:/etc/dnsmasq.d'
    restart: unless-stopped

name: Vaultwarden
description: Alternative implementation of the Bitwarden server API written in Rust, perfect for self-hosted deployments.
defaultCompose:
services:
  vaultwarden:
    image: vaultwarden/server:latest
    container_name: vaultwarden
    restart: always
    environment:
      WEBSOCKET_ENABLED: "true"
    volumes:
      - ./vw-data:/data
    ports:
      - 8081:80

name: Nextcloud
description: A safe home for all your data. A self-hosted productivity platform that keeps you in control.
defaultCompose:
services:
  db:
    image: mariadb:10.6
    restart: always
    command: --transaction-isolation=READ-COMMITTED --log-bin=binlog --binlog-format=ROW
    volumes:
      - ./db:/var/lib/mysql
    environment:
      - MYSQL_ROOT_PASSWORD=${MYSQL_ROOT_PASSWORD}
      - MYSQL_PASSWORD=${MYSQL_PASSWORD}
      - MYSQL_DATABASE=nextcloud
      - MYSQL_USER=nextcloud

  app:
    image: nextcloud
    restart: always
    ports:
      - 8082:80
    links:
      - db
    volumes:
      - ./nextcloud:/var/www/html
    environment:
      - MYSQL_PASSWORD=${MYSQL_PASSWORD}
      - MYSQL_DATABASE=nextcloud
      - MYSQL_USER=nextcloud
      - MYSQL_HOST=db

name: File Browser
description: Web File Browser which can be used as a middleware or standalone app.
defaultCompose:
services:
  filebrowser:
    image: filebrowser/filebrowser:latest
    container_name: filebrowser
    ports:
      - 8083:80
    volumes:
      - ./data:/srv
      - ./filebrowser.db:/database/filebrowser.db
    restart: always

name: Jellyfin
description: The Free Software Media System. It puts you in control of managing and streaming your media.
defaultCompose:
services:
  jellyfin:
    image: jellyfin/jellyfin:latest
    container_name: jellyfin
    user: 1000:1000
    ports:
      - 8096:8096
    volumes:
      - ./config:/config
      - ./cache:/cache
      - ./media:/media
    restart: unless-stopped

name: Gluetun
description: VPN client in a thin Docker container for multiple VPN providers, written in Go, and using OpenVPN or Wireguard.
defaultCompose:
services:
  gluetun:
    image: qmcgaw/gluetun:latest
    container_name: gluetun
    cap_add:
      - NET_ADMIN
    devices:
      - /dev/net/tun:/dev/net/tun
    ports:
      - 8888:8888/tcp
      - 8388:8388/tcp
      - 8388:8388/udp
    volumes:
      - ./gluetun:/gluetun
    environment:
      - VPN_SERVICE_PROVIDER=custom
      - VPN_TYPE=openvpn
    restart: unless-stopped
